case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Controlla la scadenza del certificato TLS di un
case.goal: Controlla la scadenza del certificato TLS di un host e scrivila in cert.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `cert.txt`.
commands: $c=[Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new('example.com',443); # then inspect the served cert notAfter
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `cert.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.
reference_solution: Run: $c=[Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new('example.com',443); # then inspect the served cert notAfter
